name: 01845 · North Andover, MA
findings: ZIP 01845 (North Andover) has 118 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01845 (North Andover) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01845 (North Andover) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
